Title: Diagnosis
Details: The test failure occurs because the `CSVRecord.toMap()` method assumes that the number of values in the record matches the number of header columns. However, if a record has fewer fields than the header columns, it will lead to an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` when attempting to create the map.

To address this issue, the `toMap()` method should be modified to handle cases where the number of values is less than the number of header columns.

The behavior described in the current bug report aligns with the observed failure in the test case, confirming the root cause.
